items.note: Between-subject study with 35 design practitioners comparing the DesignMinds VLM+LLM ideation tool with a baseline condition; reports higher flexibility and originality of ideation; below 50 participants; arXiv 2411.03827 is the preprint.

Two randomized experiments (n = 1036 combined) on smart-reply suggestions in conversations; outcomes are communication efficiency, emotional language, and partner perceptions, not creativity or diversity; arXiv 2102.05756 is the preprint.

Creative-writing experiment comparing ChatGPT collaboration designs (one AI configuration versus another); scores story quality and interestingness and aggregate diversity of stories and genres; search notes report 285 students, random assignment to designs, and a within-person no-AI day-1 baseline, which the abstract does not state.

Pre-registered experiment in which participants design toys by combining two concepts with or without generative-AI assistance; rated creativity, novelty, and appropriateness; abstract from OpenAlex (ICIS 2025, no DOI) gives no sample size or assignment method.

Experiment with 91 MBA students in teams, manipulating generative-AI use at idea generation, at idea evaluation, or not at all; outcomes are technical goodness, usefulness, and novelty of team ideas; conference abstract only, and team-level units may matter.

Online experiment (N = 1,506) in which treatment writers used an LM assistant configured to argue one side on social media; outcomes are opinions expressed in the posts (judged by 500 raters) and later attitudes, not creativity or diversity; arXiv 2302.00560 is the preprint.

Within-subject study in which 34 undergraduates did matched textile pattern tasks with conventional vector tools and with GenAI in Illustrator; reports lower creativity and aesthetic ratings and no gain in breadth of ideas, but the abstract does not say whether ratings are by raters or self-reports, or whether condition order was randomized; below 50 participants.

System paper on Sci-Fi Spark, an LLM co-creation tool for science fiction ideation, with a technical evaluation and a user study with writers that reports better novelty and consistency; the abstract does not say whether the user study has a comparison condition, so it may be system_paper_no_comparison.

Controlled experiments with 36 novice designers on a sustainable service design task with ChatGPT, Tiangong AI, or no tool; design outcomes evaluated for novelty, systematicity, originality, and sustainability; below 50 participants.

Three groups (generative AI alone, designers alone, AI-designer collaboration) tackle the same smart-home robot design challenge and experts rate creativity, empathy, and innovation; the designers-with-AI versus designers-alone contrast qualifies, the AI-alone arm is AI-versus-human context; abstract from the journal landing page notes a small-scale experiment.
